name: Stone Atronach

normal_veteran_differences: Defense Prism crystals from both Normal and Veteran Lucent Citadel counted as Stone Atronachs for the purpose of the Daily Endeavor, but it is not known if this was intended.

notes: Generic Stone Atronachs were first introduced in Update 15. Before that, the Foundation Stone Atronach from Update 1 was the only named one.

Galchobhar previously had two atronachs that he would continuously revive, and they would brace themselves by turning their stone black and eyes red and briefly halting their attacks when he threw his weapon.
A Target Stone Atronach training dummy is present in the game files, but is yet to be available.
Stone Atronachs are mentioned in the book Once.

summary: Stone Atronachs are a rare type of elemental Daedra. They resemble six-legged creatures with two towering frontal limbs, four smaller hind limbs and a central glowing eye. They are most often encountered in group dungeons. In the Bloodroot Forge, Stoneheart summons multiple stone atronachs and will periodically revive them throughout the fight if they have died. In Falkreath Hold, Domihaus the Bloody-Horned will summon one stone atronach at a time when he calls forth the atronachs of each element. In Moongrave Fane, various stone atronachs, named Moongrave Sentinels, serve the Hollowfang clan. In Earthen Root Enclave, the Corruption of Stone summons stone atronachs. In Black Gem Foundry, the Soulbinders use summoned stone atronachs to mine black soul gems.
